Technical deep dive · follow the arrows

One request through a large platform.

Orxan searches for a stay on Booking.com. This expands the conceptual path and separates published Booking.com scale from illustrative architecture.

Accuracy: Booking.com publishes individual systems, not a complete current production map. “Millions of Pods” and “hundreds of thousands of microservices” are not claimed here.

2,500+services in a published service-mesh context
3Kubernetes clusters for published Ranking Service
100sof Ranking Pods per cluster
1,000sof database servers described at scale
1

Browser → DNS → CDN edge

Static assets can be cached at an edge. Dynamic search and account requests continue inward.

Orxan · Baku
→
DNS
→
CDN / WAF
→
Global LB
TLS, DDoS protection, WAF, bot controls, static caching and coarse rate limits live near the edge. Domain authorization and quotas remain in gateway/services.
2

Global routing → regions → clusters

A region is geographic. A cluster is an independent Kubernetes control plane plus worker-node pool.

Region A · EU WestCluster A1 · A2
Region B · EU CentralCluster B1 · B2
Region C · AsiaCluster C1 · C2
ROUTE · nearest healthy region → healthy cluster
3

Cluster → nodes → namespace → workloads

Scheduler places Pods on nodes. Deployments declare replicas and rollout policy; Services expose stable discovery and Ready endpoints.

Control plane

Worker nodes

Isolation, upgrades, capacity, compliance and smaller blast radius. Applications can repeat across clusters; databases and brokers need separate replication strategies.

Gateway → Kubernetes Services → domain Pods

6

Database primary → replicas → promotion

Writes go to primary. Replicas scale reads and recovery. Failover promotes a caught-up replica and redirects clients; Kubernetes alone does not ensure database consistency.

MySQL Primary
read/write
⇒ binlog ⇒
Replica 1
read-only
Replica N
read / DR
DB · primary healthy · replicas caught up
7

Events → Kafka or RabbitMQ → workers

Slow side effects leave the request path. Booking.com has publicly described Kafka-based event routing.

booking.confirmed
→
Kafka
stream · replay
or
RabbitMQ
work queue
→
Workers
email · analytics
Kafka fits durable ordered streams, replay and consumer groups. RabbitMQ fits task queues, acknowledgements and flexible routing. Poison messages move to a dead-letter path after bounded retries.
8

Payment provider → webhook → reconciliation

A timeout is unknown—not failure. Persist attempts, reuse idempotency keys, verify signed webhooks, deduplicate events and reconcile state.
